subject: Close timeline drift — root cause, mitigation asks, and escalation path
messages:
From: Ari Kaplan <ari@stellicorp.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@stellicorp.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Concern: acceptance window slipping

Priyom,

Quick note from the Stellicorp side — the acceptance window we agreed to in the MAP is starting to slip against two internal milestones: security signoff and payment approval. Our security lead flagged the new audit schedule and procurement is asking for an updated delivery cadence.

Can you confirm what changed on your side and whether we can still hit the agreed acceptance target of 2025-06-20? If not, we need a short risks note and a proposed revised acceptance window so procurement can re-run approvals.

Thanks,
Ari Kaplan
Head of Platform Integrations
Stellicorp

---
Attachment: none
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari@stellicorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Concern: acceptance window slipping

Ari — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the stress. Summary and immediate actions below.

Root cause (short):
- Two upstream items shifted this week: a model quantization iteration took longer than predicted, and our QA discovered a memory edge-case during long-sequence evals. Both pushed back the internal cutover by ~4 business days.

What weve done so far:
- Compiled a one-page risk log and updated the MAP with revised milestone dates (see attachment).
- Opened a focused canary plan so we can deploy a trimmed model variant to a subset of traffic to preserve the original acceptance window as an option.

Immediate ask for Stellicorp:
1) Can procurement confirm if they can absorb a 5 business day shift to acceptance, or do they need a hard date for approvals to proceed now?
2) Security: who is the point contact for the audit reschedule so we can sync timelines?

Attachments: risk_log_v1.xlsx, MAP_v3.pdf

I will loop in product and eng to assign owners and document mitigations. If acceptance must remain 2025-06-20 we will prioritize the canary fallback and provide an operational runbook by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Eng, Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.com

---
Attachments: risk_log_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), MAP_v3.pdf (pdf)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ari Kaplan <ari@stellicorp.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jun 2025 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Concern: acceptance window slipping

Team — assigning ownership and next steps. Priyom, thanks for the clear summary to the customer.

Internal actions (owners):
- Dylan: own the canary plan execution and KPI gating (latency, error-rate, token costs). Target: canary live by 2025-06-05.
- Grace: lead QA triage on the memory edge-case and produce a regression test by 2025-06-04. If fix is non-trivial we will publish a remediation ETA.
- Priyom: coordinate with procurement + security at Stellicorp and confirm whether acceptance can slip.

Procurement asks to prepare for (I will draft):
- A concise deviation memo for Stellicorp procurement that summarizes root cause, mitigations, and contingency acceptance criteria.

Also attaching the initial risk log for our internal tracker. Please append status updates directly to the risk log so we avoid fragmented notes.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: risk_log_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Ari Kaplan <ari@stellicorp.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@stellicorp.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Jun 2025 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Concern: acceptance window slipping

Thanks for the analysis. Procurement can accept a 5 business day shift, but they need the formal deviation memo and a final acceptance checklist by 2025-06-10 to keep our payment approval on track. Security will assign a point person once we have the updated MAP dates.

Proposed revised acceptance window: 2025-06-25 to 2025-06-28 (soft). If you can deliver the deviation memo and the canary runbook by 2025-06-10, procurement will not block.

Ari

---
Attachment: none
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari@stellicorp.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Jun 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Concern: acceptance window slipping — escalation & exec ask

Ari / team — closing the loop and escalating the decision path so execs on both sides have clarity.

Status summary:
- Root cause confirmed: quantization iteration + long-sequence memory regression. Impact: ~5 business day delay to the nominal acceptance path.
- Canary plan: trimmed model variant ready; Dylan has a gating plan to evaluate live on low-volume traffic. Target canary start 2025-06-05, results due 2025-06-09.
- QA: Grace will publish the regression report on 2025-06-04. If the fix is medium effort we expect a code patch and regression deploy by 2025-06-15.

Customer asks we will meet:
- Deviations memo: Priyom to draft and circulate by 2025-06-09.
- Acceptance checklist / runbook: will be delivered 2025-06-10.

Exec ask and fallback: if procurement requires a signed date commitment before 2025-06-10, we propose the following escalation path:
1) Exec alignment call between Ari, Laura, and Redwood VP of Product (cc list below) within 24 hours of that request.
2) If canary KPIs meet thresholds, Redwood will honor a soft acceptance window of 2025-06-25 to 2025-06-28. If canary fails, we will request a formal rebaseline and provide a mitigation credit schedule for delayed acceptance.

Attachments: procurement_questions-answered.pdf (answers to procurement RFI). HubSpot deal link and internal risk log attached here: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4782 and https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aBcdExample/view?usp=sharing

Next steps (immediate):
- Laura to finalize deviation memo template and send to procurement 2025-06-03 (in flight).
- Priyom to circulate final deviation memo by 2025-06-09.
- Dylan to post canary results by 2025-06-09 and tag the HubSpot deal.

Thanks all; I will escalate to VP of Product and include the execs if procurement pushes for a locked date ahead of our mitigation window.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Eng, Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.com

---
Attachments: procurement_questions-answered.pdf (pdf), risk_log_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
